data.one_liner: Upgrade and install applications on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to handle self-updates, download APKs or patches with progress monitoring, trigger installs, and redirect users to app stores like Google Play or Apple App Store.
use_when: You need in-app updates via custom download links or app stores.
You want to monitor download progress for large updates.
avoid_when: You only want official platform store update dialogs without custom downloading logic.
You are developing for web or desktop platforms.
strengths: Supports multiple upgrade flavors including normal, hot, and incremental upgrades.
Provides stream listeners for tracking download speed, progress, and status.
weaknesses: Platform support is limited to Android and iOS.
Requires manual permission configurations and platform setup.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding permissions like REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES and WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE for Android, and configuring optional notification styles or xml values.
